Looked to be down and out.

斯维亚泰克这记正手失误了。

Oh!
哦！

There it is again.
又来了。

The Donna Vekic drop shot special.

quote.text:
A crushing return winner from Iga Swiatek.
斯维亚泰克接发直接得分！

Donna Vekic with two chances to close out the match.
维基奇两次有机会结束比赛。

Unable to do so.
却没能做到。

Iga Swiatek storms back, and...
斯维亚泰克强势追了回来……

What a tiebreak she played.
这个抢七，她打得太出色了。

Seven points to none in that tiebreak.

抢七一分没让

And then the comeback is complete.
逆转就这样完成了。

What a way to finish for Iga Swiatek.
斯维亚泰克精彩地结束比赛！

Looked to be down and out.
她看起来已陷入绝境。

Was facing a 5-2 deficit
当时，她以二比五落后，

in the second set after dropping the first.
